verses.he: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: O come, let us sing unto the LORD; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.he: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: For the LORD is a great God, And a great King above all gods;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; The heights of the mountains are His also.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃
verses.en: The sea is His, and He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.

verses.he: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃
verses.en: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

verses.he: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!

verses.he: אַל־תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃
verses.en: When your fathers tried Me, Proved Me, even though they saw My work.

verses.he: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה׀ אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃
verses.en: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, And said: It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known My ways;
Wherefore I swore in My wrath, That they should not enter into My arest.'
